title: 1. Chevron Corporation and 2. Texaco Petroleum Company v. The Republic of Ecuador
description: The PCA is providing administrative support in this arbitration, which is being conducted under the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules pursuant to the Treaty between the United States of America and the Republic of Ecuador concerning the Encouragement and Reciprocal Protection of Investment.
document_label: First Interim Award on Interim Measures; Second Interim Award on Interim Measures; Third Interim Award on Jurisdiction and Admissibility; Fourth Interim Award on Interim Measures; First Partial Award on Track I; Decision on Track I(B); Note of Dissent by Dr. Horacio Grigera Naón; Second Partial Award on Track II; Decision on the Respondent's Request for Interpretation under Article 35 of the UNCITRAL Arbitration Rules; Partial Award on Threshold Issues of Track III; Fourth Partial Award on Track III (Public Version); Note of Partial Dissent by Dr. Horacio Grigera Naon; Decision on Correction of Fourth Partial Award on Track III; Note of Dissent
